title: negation
tests: "I don't have any access to their systems anymore" → internal_source refuted, no R2
transcript:
[00:00:05] Analyst (Priya): Do you still have any visibility into Halvorsen's order book?
[00:00:27] Expert (R. Castellano): No. I don't have any access to their systems anymore. I handed everything back when I left in July.
[00:00:49] Analyst (Priya): Understood. So what are you seeing on demand?
[00:01:11] Expert (R. Castellano): What I hear from the distributors I work with now is that orders for industrial pumps are down maybe ten percent this fall. That's their view, not a Halvorsen number.

non_findings.why: distributor sample observed from outside; the expert denies any system access

extraction_note: Hand-labeled claims in the extract-v1 output shape, for deterministic tests without a model call.
